steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Primary data is collected firsthand by the investigator for a specific purpose. | Key Fact: Secondary data is data that already exists, collected by someone else for a different purpose. | Key Fact: Methods of collecting primary data include experiments, surveys/questionnaires and observation. | Key Fact: An experiment involves deliberately changing a variable and measuring the effect (e.g. clinical trials).
